## Accepted items
Curbside recycling accepts clean paper, cardboard, metal cans, glass bottles, and plastic containers marked 1, 2, or 5. Items should be empty, dry, and loose in the blue cart.

## Not accepted
Plastic bags, foam, food waste, and batteries do not belong in the blue cart. Batteries should go to a household hazardous-waste site.
